# lnkd DraStic skins

Author: lnkd. Source: https://lnkd.itch.io/drastic-custom-skins
Downloaded 2026-10-20 through the author's **Android Skins - Free Collection**
link. The paid Plus collection is not included.

Unchanged background images from these two free archives are included at the
user's request:

- `DraStic DSPhat-OGSilver.zip`
- `DraStic Analogue-Black.zip`

For each archive, the selected files are `backgrounds/landscape_16x9.png`,
`backgrounds/landscape_16x9_layout-sidebyside.png`,
`backgrounds/landscape_16x9_layout-bigsmall.png` and
`backgrounds/portrait_16x9.png`. Their descriptive filenames in this folder
identify the style and layout; image contents have not been modified.

The download page and archives do not supply an explicit open-source
redistribution license. These artworks remain the author's property and are
not covered by DrasticDS_nx's code license. Nintendo names and designs belong
to Nintendo. Additional styles and the paid collection are available directly
from the author at the source link above.

The adjacent `.png.layout` files are DrasticDS_nx metadata for matching game
screen positions and portrait rotation, generated for this port.
